name: BuffSkillFragileAdd
description: Fragile Effect — adds bonus damage based on attacker's attribute or current HP. Applied to DEFENDER as a debuff, checked by attacker during damage calculation.

usage_context.description: Applied to defender. During normal attack, counter, and skill damage, the attacker iterates over defender's FRAGILE_EFFECT buffs and adds the result to damage.
usage_context.code_pattern: for each fragile in defender.getBuffByType(FRAGILE_EFFECT): damage += fragile.calDamage(damage, attacker)

alloc_parameters._attribId: config.param2 — attribute ID to use when calType=0

parameters.t: Current damage value (unused in calculation, bonus is added separately)

calType_0.example: If attribId=1001 (ATK) and skillPar=0.2, adds 20% of attacker's ATK as flat damage

calType_1.description: HP-based: bonus = attacker's current HP × skillPar
calType_1.example: If skillPar=0.1, adds 10% of attacker's current HP as flat damage

calDamage.return: Flat bonus damage to be ADDED to existing damage

key_distinction: Unlike EXTRA_DAMAGE which multiplies, FRAGILE_EFFECT adds a flat bonus based on attacker stats. It's checked on the DEFENDER (as a debuff), not the attacker.
